conclusion: In this paper, we introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. It unifies TG, SG, and QA across VL and AV tracks with paired Text and Text+Image specifications for the same video, target, task semantics, and ground truth. The benchmark covers 820 manually annotated videos across seven domains, including a 240-video AV subset with native audio. The paired settings and CS metric assess both prediction correctness and consistency under changes in target specification. Leading proprietary models outperform open-source models, especially in audio-visual understanding, while precise grounding, fine-grained perception, and audio-visual event binding remain challenging.
